name: Perpetual Yeast
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Add 3 cups potato water, 1 cup granulated sugar and 1 White Swan Yeast Cake together
Let stand 48 hours where temperature is moderate, then seal in 2 quart can and set in cool place
At noon, save 3 cups potato water and add 3/4 cup granulated sugar
At night take 3 cups of this liquid and to it add 3 cups warm water (always cup for cup)
Allow 3 cups of flour to 1 of liquid
Add 1 tablespoon butter and 1 tablespoon salt
Knead well and put in pan to rise
If yeast is put with potato water at night you may knead stiff in morning
Grease loaves with melted butter just before placing in oven

source.originalInstructions:
1. Add 3 cups potato water, 1 cup granulated sugar and 1 White Swan Yeast Cake together
2. Let stand 48 hours where temperature is moderate, then seal in 2 quart can and set in cool place
3. At noon, save 3 cups potato water and add 3/4 cup granulated sugar
4. Pour in the yeast
5. At night take 3 cups of this liquid and to it add 3 cups warm water (always cup for cup)
6. Allow 3 cups of flour to 1 of liquid
7. Add 1 tablespoon butter and 1 tablespoon salt
8. Knead well and put in pan to rise
9. In morning make into loaves
10. If yeast is put with potato water at night you may knead stiff in morning
11. Grease loaves with melted butter just before placing in oven
